task.title: Querying image vulnerabilities from the CLI
task.shortdesc: To check for security vulnerabilities in your Red Hat Quay container images, you can query vulnerability information from the command line using the oc get vuln command. You can also view detailed information about specific vulnerabilities by using the oc describe vuln command.

step.cmd: Enter the following command to query for detected vulnerabilities:

info.codeblock: NAMESPACE NAME AGE default sha256.ca90... 6m56s skynet sha256.ca90... 9m37s
